entries.source: he war drums had begun at dawn.
entries.translation: 戰鼓在破曉時分擂響。

entries.source: Stalking quietly the corridors of the ancient fortress, Narab carried a witchlight to illumine his way. As he approached the doors to the Great Hall, two moredhel guards dressed in full battle regalia stood away. They made no sound as he whisked past nor blinked at the sight of him.
entries.translation: 納拉布靜靜地潛行在這座古老堡壘的迴廊間，手持一盞妖光為自己照路。他走近大殿的門扉時，兩名身披全套戰甲的莫瑞德守衛退到一旁。他匆匆掠過時，他們沒有出聲，見了他也不眨一下眼。

entries.source: "Greetings, Narab," a cold voice called from the throne. "It has long been since I have seen your face in Sar-Sargoth. Have you grown bolder or more the fool?"
entries.translation: 「問候你，納拉布。」王座那頭傳來一個冰冷的聲音。「我已經很久沒在薩薩戈斯見過你這張臉了。你是變得更大膽，還是更蠢？」

entries.source: Narab knelt at the base of the throne and kissed Delekhan's foot. "That is for you to decide. If my words are not to your liking, then my life is yours."
entries.translation: 納拉布在王座底下跪倒，親吻迪勒肯的腳。「那由您來裁定。若我的話不合您的意，那我的命就是您的。」

entries.source: "It is already mine." Delekhan's wolfish eyes blazed in the darkness. "Speak," he commanded.
entries.translation: 「它早就是我的了。」迪勒肯那雙如狼的眼睛在黑暗中灼灼燃燒。「說。」他下令道。

entries.source: "I have just returned from a journey into the Kingdom. I bring a prize."
entries.translation: 「我剛從深入王國的一趟旅程回來。我帶回了一件戰利品。」

entries.source: "I have no interest in valueless baubles..."
entries.translation: 「我對毫無價值的玩意兒沒興趣…」

entries.source: "This is no bauble," Narab said, cutting off Delekhan, "and I think you will find it is of great value."
entries.translation: 「這不是什麼玩意兒。」納拉布打斷迪勒肯的話，「我想您會發現它價值連城。」

entries.source: "And would it have name, this thing?"
entries.translation: 「那這東西，可有名字？」

entries.source: "Yes, my lord. Its name is Gorath!" Narab sneered pridefully as he awaited his leader's praise, awaited the words that would restore his place in moredhel favor and rescind the order of death on his head. Perhaps he would even have a place among the new lords...
entries.translation: 「有的，我的主上。它的名字是戈拉斯！」納拉布傲然冷笑，等著首領的讚許，等著那些能讓他重獲莫瑞德人青睞、撤銷他頭上死刑令的話語。說不定他甚至能在新的領主之列占有一席之地…

entries.source: Delekhan lunged from his throne, his razor edged gauntlet tilling a bloody seam across Narab's face as he lashed him backwards.
entries.translation: 迪勒肯從王座上猛撲而下，那副刀鋒般的護手在納拉布臉上犁出一道血痕，將他一把甩得向後跌去。

entries.source: "You've wrecked everything you dog!" Delekhan bellowed.
entries.translation: 「你毀了一切，你這條狗！」迪勒肯咆哮道。

entries.source: "But...I have brought back the enemy of the Northlands!" Narab sputtered, blood dripping from his torn lips. "With Gorath captive we can proceed with our..."
entries.translation: 「可是…我把北境的仇敵帶回來了啊！」納拉布結結巴巴地說，血從他撕裂的嘴唇上滴落。「有戈拉斯在手，我們就能繼續進行我們的…」

entries.source: "You...know...nothing!"
entries.translation: 「你…什麼…都不懂！」

entries.source: Narab retreated, suddenly aware that his efforts were wasted, that his oath of loyalty meant nothing to his hateful lord. Resolutely he stifled a flash of pain as the moredhel leader thundered towards the doors.
entries.translation: 納拉布往後退去，忽然明白自己一番心血全都白費，明白他的效忠誓言在這位可憎的主上眼中一文不值。莫瑞德首領大步朝門口衝去時，他硬生生把一陣刺痛忍了下來。

entries.source: "And what of my life?" Narab whispered.
entries.translation: 「那我的命呢？」納拉布低聲問。

entries.source: Halting, Delekhan turned and hissed, "It is forfeit!"
entries.translation: 迪勒肯停下腳步，轉過身嘶聲道：「你的命，沒了！」

entries.source: Owyn didn't want to be awake.
entries.translation: 歐文並不想醒著。

entries.source: Perhaps it was the drugs they had given him or the endless walking that he'd done in the past month and a half. All he could think about was sleeping now, that restful non-existence that interrupted the beatings and the hauling and the exhaustion. He just wanted to sleep but that irritating jangle wouldn't let him. Where was it coming from?
entries.translation: 也許是他們餵他服下的藥物，也許是這一個半月來走不完的路。此刻他滿腦子只想睡覺——那種讓毆打、拖行與疲憊都暫時消失的安穩虛無。他只想睡，可那惱人的叮噹聲卻不讓他睡。那聲音究竟是從哪裡傳來的？

entries.source: "Gorath?" Owyn asked. "Are you there?"
entries.translation: 「戈拉斯？」歐文問。「你在嗎？」

entries.source: Suddenly the jangle rattled louder, this time accompanied by a loud creak and a flood of torchlight as bright as the sun. Out of that glowing corona lumbered the largest moredhel he had yet seen...
entries.translation: 那叮噹聲忽然響得更兇，這回還伴著一記沉重的嘎吱聲，以及一片亮如白晝的火炬光。從那團光暈中，笨重地走出了他生平所見最巨大的莫瑞德人…
